selection_rules:
that pass the threshold and the three lowest-scoring overlapping pairs below it; the first three prerequisite flags, two redundancy
    flags and one emerging-topic gap the reference labels call wrong; the first topic the detector calls covered although the labels
    see a gap; and the two Bloom errors furthest from the faculty tag. Root causes and fixes: reports/failure_notes.json.

cases.evidence: Computer network layers and protocols vs cloud computing layers and containers; cloud is only mentioned in CN future-networks overview.
cases.root_cause: Both syllabi use networking-layer vocabulary (layers, protocols, services, virtualisation), so lexical and semantic scores pass the threshold although the subjects differ.
cases.fix_or_limitation: Weight matches by distinctive topic terms and require several matched units, not one high course score.

cases.input: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles vs Engineering Mechanics
cases.evidence: Both teach rigid-body kinematics and dynamics (forces, moments, motion), but A is otherwise UAV types, guidance and regulation while B covers statics, friction, trusses and centroids.
cases.root_cause: Only one unit-level topic (rigid-body dynamics) is shared inside otherwise different courses, so the whole-course score stays below the threshold.
cases.fix_or_limitation: Report partial overlap from the unit-level detector (best unit pair) instead of the course score.

cases.input: Cybersecurity for Non-IT vs Foundation of Information systems
cases.evidence: Security threats and safeguards for information systems are taught in both, but B is mostly IS strategy, ERP/CRM, e-commerce and A covers crypto, IAM, firewalls.
cases.root_cause: One security unit is shared; the rest of each course (IS strategy vs cryptography, IAM) pulls the course score down.
cases.fix_or_limitation: Same as above: unit-level evidence for partial overlap.

cases.input: Cognitive Science & Analytics vs Advanced Business Analytics in Python and R
cases.evidence: Both teach basic inferential statistics (hypothesis testing, ANOVA, correlation) and ML techniques, but A adds cognitive science/AI breadth while B focuses on regression and model evaluation in Python/R.
cases.root_cause: Shared statistics topics (hypothesis testing, ANOVA) are phrased differently and sit inside larger, different courses.
cases.fix_or_limitation: Unit-level evidence; a domain-adapted encoder for statistics wording.

cases.input: Open Elective - I (BSC) - Fundamentals of Fuels and Lubricants (CIVIL) needs 'Chemistry (Semester- II)'
cases.root_cause: The phrase keeps '(Semester- II)' and the first-year chemistry course has a different name, so neither the name nor the topic match passes.
cases.fix_or_limitation: Strip semester and code annotations from phrases; link common first-year courses to every programme explicitly.

cases.input: Open Elective - I (BSC) - Modelling and Simulation (CIVIL) needs 'Engineering Mathematics'
cases.evidence: Calculus, Linear Algebra and Mathematics - III are taught earlier.
cases.root_cause: 'Engineering Mathematics' names a group of courses (Calculus, Linear Algebra, Mathematics - III); it resolves to a same-named course of another programme that Civil does not offer.
cases.fix_or_limitation: A small ontology of umbrella subjects mapped to their member courses.

cases.input: Remote Sensing, GIS and Data Science Applications in Environmental Management (CIVIL) needs 'geography'
cases.evidence: Generic background phrase; Introduction to Earth Sciences, Geology and Surveying provide the needed geographic grounding.
cases.root_cause: A background phrase ('geography') is treated as a required course; no earlier unit is close enough to it.
cases.fix_or_limitation: Classify phrases as subject or background before checking (e.g. the LLM extractor).

cases.input: Design of Reinforced Concrete Structures vs Design of Steel Structures
cases.evidence: Limit state design is applied to different materials (RCC per IS 456 vs steel sections); not the same content.
cases.root_cause: Both courses teach limit-state design, so the unit texts share method vocabulary although the material differs (concrete vs steel).
cases.fix_or_limitation: Require overlap of the domain nouns, or a stricter duplicate threshold for design units.

cases.input: Introduction to Cryptography vs Elliptic Curve Cryptography
cases.evidence: Broad survey of RSA, Rabin, ElGamal versus in-depth ECC protocols (ECDH, Schnorr, ECDSA); only minor overlap.
cases.root_cause: Public-key cryptography appears in both, as a survey in one and in depth in the other; the unit score cannot see depth.
cases.fix_or_limitation: Compare hours and outcome levels of matched units; report as partial, not redundant.

cases.key: emerging_covered|Large language models and generative AI|CSBS
cases.input: 'Large language models and generative AI' in programme CSBS
cases.evidence: Closest units are compiler code generation, cognitive science and RNNs; no LLM or generative AI unit.
cases.root_cause: The topic threshold reused from the prerequisite check lets weakly related units (code generation, RNNs) count as coverage.
cases.fix_or_limitation: Tune a separate threshold for emerging topics on labelled checks; this also explains the low gap recall.

cases.key: bloom|Apply, Deploy, and Manage the applicatio
cases.input: Apply, Deploy, and Manage the applications efficiently while evaluating and integrating best practices in real-world scenarios.
cases.root_cause: The lexicon takes the first known verb ('apply'), but the outcome also asks to evaluate and integrate, which the faculty tag as Create.
cases.fix_or_limitation: Use the highest-level verb, or the classifier, when an outcome has several verbs.

cases.key: bloom|Construct the curves using surveying ins
cases.input: Construct the curves using surveying instruments
cases.root_cause: 'Construct' is Create in Bloom verb lists, but constructing survey curves is a practical skill the faculty tag as Apply.
cases.fix_or_limitation: A domain-specific verb map learned from faculty tags (needs more tagged outcomes).
